A vehicle receives a software update over the air. Before installing it, the vehicle checks the signature of the update package, confirms that the battery charge is above a threshold, and verifies that the car is parked. During installation the previous version is kept so that the system can roll back if the new version fails its self-test after reboot. After a successful update, the vehicle reports the new version to the server and deletes the old copy only after one more successful start. Question: list, in order, the checks and actions that happen before, during and after the installation.
